title: Agent maxTurns is honored

stimulus.prompt: Use the {{AGENT_PREFIX}}probe-maxturns agent to read steps/step1.txt through steps/step5.txt, one file per turn. Don't read any file yourself. Reply with what the agent returned.

observations.description: The main thread asked for the agent (an Agent or Task PreToolUse was recorded).
The probe-maxturns agent actually started (a SubagentStart whose agent_type names it); a requested spawn can still fail, for example on a wrong agent name, and another agent's start doesn't count.
The agent itself attempted at least one step read, so fewer-than-five isn't met by an agent that read nothing; main-thread reads don't count.
Fewer than 5 step reads by the agent happened (maxTurns: 2 cut the task short); main-thread reads, for example after the agent stops, don't count.

status_rules.confirmed: the agent stops with a partial result after fewer than 5 steps
status_rules.contradicted: the agent completed all 5 steps despite maxTurns: 2
status_rules.inconclusive: the spawn was never requested, no SubagentStart named the agent, or the agent itself never attempted a step read; or A1 isn't confirmed for the same host version and install

notes: verify in T0: permission rule syntax in the templates (Bash(echo *), WebFetch(domain:...), mcp__...)

Attribution: observations about the agent match only payloads whose agent_type ends in probe-maxturns (script) or probe:probe-maxturns (plugin), so the main thread can't decide the case. It requires A1: the result is inconclusive unless A1 is confirmed for the same host version and install.
